notes.subject: זֻלּוּת
notes.rationale: זולות appears only here in the Tanakh; from the root זול (cheap, contemptible), rendered 'viltà' (vileness).

notes.subject: כְּרֻם זֻלּוּת
notes.rationale: 'when vileness is exalted' (KJV/ASV take it as passive with כרום as pual of רום) vs 'as vileness is exalted by the sons of men' (YLT takes בני אדם as agent).

notes.subject: rasħaqin
notes.rationale: רשעים is 'the wicked' in its concrete sense of actively bad persons; Maltese 'rasħaq' keeps the Semitic root.

translation: Minn kullimkien ir-rasħaqin iduru, meta l-viltà tiġi mgħollija fost il-bniedem.
